faq.033.en: Does an exact chart mean my life is fixed?
faq.033.zh: 命盘算得精确，是不是说明命运就定了？

faq.034.en: No — "deterministic" describes the computation, not your future. The tradition itself ranks fate as one factor among several ("first fate, second luck, third fengshui",
faq.034.zh: 不是。“确定性”说的是计算过程，不是你的未来。传统本身也把命运看作几个因素之一，所谓“一命二运三风水”

faq.035.en: ). Precision matters so the actionable layers — colours, directions, dates, rooms — rest on solid ground.

faq.036.en: Why do I sometimes see two charts for one home?
faq.036.zh: 为什么同一处住宅有时会看到两张盘？

faq.037.en: Your measured facing sits near a chart boundary (mixed facing,
faq.037.zh: 你量得的朝向靠近飞星盘的分界线，即兼向

faq.039.en: ). A fraction of a degree decides which flying-star chart rules the house, so the engine computes both candidates and tells you to re-measure on site — instead of silently picking one.
faq.039.zh: 。只差零点几度，就可能换成另一张飞星盘，所以引擎会把两种可能都算出来，并提示你到现场重新测量，而不是悄悄替你选一个。

faq.040.en: My birth time is uncertain — can I still get a reading?
faq.040.zh: 我的出生时间不确定，还能得到解读吗？

faq.041.en: Yes. Mark the time as unknown and the engine computes everything that does not need the hour pillar, flagging the sections that do rather than faking them.
faq.041.zh: 可以。把时间标为“不详”，引擎会算出所有不依赖时柱的内容，凡是需要时柱的部分会明确标出，而不是硬编一个结果。

faq.043.en: What do you store, and where?
faq.043.zh: 你的哪些信息会被保存，存在哪里？

faq.044.en: Only what you enter: names or labels, birth data, and any floor plans you upload. It lives in a workspace behind an unguessable private link — no account, no email, no password. Anyone you give the link to can view the workspace, so treat it like a key.
faq.044.zh: 只保存你填写的内容：姓名或代号、出生数据，以及你上传的户型图。它们放在一个猜不到的私密链接后面的个人空间里，无需注册账号、邮箱或密码。拿到链接的人都能查看这个个人空间，所以请像对待钥匙一样保管。

faq.045.en: How long is my workspace kept?

faq.046.en: Workspaces expire automatically after about six months of inactivity. Revisiting your link keeps it alive.
faq.046.zh: 个人空间如果约六个月没人使用，会自动过期。再次打开你的链接，就会续期。

faq.047.en: Do you sell or share my data?
faq.047.zh: 你们会出售或分享我的数据吗？

faq.048.en: No. Your data exists to compute your readings, full stop.
faq.048.zh: 不会。你的数据只用来推算你的解读，仅此而已。

faq.051.en: Yes — everything is free during early access. If paid tiers arrive later, the free chart and the citation-first principle stay.
faq.051.zh: 免费。早期体验期间一切功能免费。日后若推出付费版本，免费的命盘和“出处优先”的原则不变。

faq.052.en: How many people and homes can one workspace hold?
faq.052.zh: 一个个人空间能放多少人和住宅？

faq.053.en: Up to 8 people and up to 6 homes — enough for a family comparing properties, with a side-by-side battlecard across every analyzed home.
faq.053.zh: 最多 8 人、6 处住宅，足够一家人比较房子，并可对所有已分析的住宅生成并排对比卡。
